trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own.

steps.text: Work through the other 54 trophies in stage order; the platinum unlocks the moment the last one lands, with no extra task of its own.
Watch the trophy list counter climb toward 54 of 54 as you finish each stage, and save the hardest cleanup for last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing at the start of Chapter 1 and see it through to the end.
The trophy pops as the mission ends; it is story-locked and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops as Chapter 2 begins.

steps.text: Play through every main mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes.
The trophy lands when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens in Vice City.

steps.text: Play through every main mission of Chapter 2 until the chapter closes.
The trophy lands when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions.

steps.text: Play through every main mission of Chapter 3 until the chapter closes.
The trophy lands after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life, are done.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4; the trophy pops after its final mission, Starting From Zero.

steps.text: Play through every main mission of Chapter 4 until the chapter closes.
The trophy lands after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, is done.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission; keep a save from just before it, since there is no mission replay.

steps.text: Play the final story mission through to the credits and the gold trophy pops.
Guides word the final mission's place differently: some call it Chapter 5, while PowerPyx ties it to the Chapter 4 mission Starting From Zero; both versions are shown, neither is picked here.
Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

trophies.disagree_note: Final mission placement: Chapter 5 (eGamers, citing Beebom and CULTR) vs the Chapter 4 mission Starting From Zero (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run; it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run through to its end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it is story-locked and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist; it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist through to its end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it is story-locked and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play; it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play through to its end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it is story-locked and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners; it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners through to its end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it is story-locked and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown; it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown through to its end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it is story-locked and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory; it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it is story-locked and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Clear the 100% checklist after the story: robberies, collectibles, activities and 70 of 80 challenges.

steps.text: Finish the story first; the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work done earlier already counts.
Clear the robbery rows: all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and all 8 bank vaults.
Clear the collectible rows: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater finds, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and 100 of 255 animals studied.
Clear the activity rows: 30 of 40 races won, all 42 shooting range golds, all 42 drone time trials and 300 of 397 stunts.
Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges; the 10 hardest can be skipped entirely.
Remember the checklist is closer to 60% true completion, and nothing on it is missable, so it can all be done in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts; under-the-bridge flights are the quickest kind.

steps.text: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida; the four kinds are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Fly under bridges first: they are the quickest kind to clear, and you can mix kinds freely to reach 250.
Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, pressing R3 on a category for the regional split.
Keep going past 250 if you want the platinum: the 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once; most happen on their own while you play.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Check what you have tried under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, where scrolling over each type shows your count.
Most types turn up on their own during the story and the other trophies, so do not grind this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges.

steps.text: Visit the shooting ranges and earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 challenges.
There are 12 ranges holding the 42 challenges between them, so work through each range in turn.
The 100% checklist also asks for all 42 golds, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
Raise your Focus level first if the timed shots feel tight: shooting range play itself builds Focus.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; one win per spot is enough.

steps.text: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations around Leonida.
There are 42 drone races in total across those spots, but the trophy only needs one win at each location.
The 100% checklist is stricter and asks for all 42 drone time trials, so keep racing past the trophy if you want the platinum.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race spots.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; winning the same race twice does not add to the count.
There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the shortest and easiest ones first.
The 100% checklist asks for 30 of the 40 races won, so keep racing past the trophy if you want the platinum.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline after he texts you and beat him in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Play past the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text message, which marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map.
Follow Cal's fishing questline to its challenge and beat him there to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games.

steps.text: Pick any of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
Play the first three at the TV in your home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck sits at arcade machines around the world.
Finish every level of your chosen game at least once; you do not need to beat all of its challenges.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots with both leads, and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before it vanishes.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, then look for Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house the next morning.
Follow her out to the balcony and choose Accept when she offers to meditate with you.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy has popped, because there is no mission replay and the balcony moment never comes back.
At each marked spot, meditate with both leads: one spot then counts twice toward the total.
The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Check your count under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations after each session.
The counts differ between sources: guides say 18 meditations for this trophy while the 100% list stops at 15, so both numbers are shown here.

trophies.disagree_note: Meditation count: 18 for the trophy (PowerPyx, KeenGamer) vs 15 for the 100% checklist (KeenGamer, eGamers) — different scopes, both shown.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, then escape the police.

steps.text: Reach the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, which is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation before you go in; you need them to crack the safe.
Take the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway.
Escape the police and the trophy pops; if you missed an item, the operation comes back later, so this one is not missable.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest Cellerica line in Chapter 3; it is Lucia-only and stays open after the story.

steps.text: Wait for Andy's questline to be marked automatically in Chapter 3; it is only available while playing as Lucia.
Answer Andy's call during Chapter 3, then read her text with her home address in Belville to mark the line on the map.
Work through her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain in three parts, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
Finish the last quest and the trophy pops; every Andy quest stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear Kenton's 7 shipwreck treasure sets; he goes quiet for a while but always comes back.

steps.text: Let Kenton's questline mark itself in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and the green KR icon appears in Key Lento.
Follow his purple treasure chest icons, dive for the wrecks and dig with the metal detector, then bring each haul back to Kenton.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks for his line; after each set he calls you back and marks more spots on the map.

Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures; he goes quiet in Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3, so he is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5 jobs from the Thrillbilly Mudclub; they stay open after the story.

steps.text: Wait for Billy's questline to mark itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through his 5 jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
Steal the Impaler as part of the line and join Billy on the jobs he marks.
Finish the last job and the trophy pops; all of Billy's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands; do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida; only certain lines count, and Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses, Yasmani and Eddie do not.
The strands confirmed to count are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, each with several missions of their own.
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3: it carries an hourglass icon and is time-sensitive, so save first and race at once.
The strand list is still open: guides name 4 confirmed strands while also saying more are yet to be discovered, so both versions are shown here.
Check the trophy tracker counter after each strand you finish to see which ones counted.

trophies.disagree_note: Which strands count: 4 named strands confirmed (PowerPyx, GTA-Zone) vs more yet to be discovered (PowerPyx, OutputLog) — both shown.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver Randy's 16 sports cars from his wish list; the Key Cloner opens the line in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Wait for Randy's questline to mark itself after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner.
Read Randy's list of 16 sports cars he wants and track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage.
Deliver each car in good condition for more pay; cars turn up often in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and new spots get marked as you deliver.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Smash Tyrone's synthetic labs as Jason, then finish his second quest Spin On This.

steps.text: Wait for Tyrone's questline to mark itself after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; it is only available as Jason.
Follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work Bret's Jason-only hunting line; which animal unlocks it is still unconfirmed.

steps.text: Wait for Bret Vogel's questline to mark itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; while playing as Jason you get his text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Meet Bret, then hunt the animals he requests at the purple-marked spots and bring them back to him as Jason.
It is still unconfirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so work the whole line and watch for the pop.
Bret hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on his first quest; a clean single shot keeps a carcass pristine and pays more, though it is not required.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets found across Leonida.

steps.text: Collect cards across Leonida until you complete any 3 full sets out of the 18 in the game.
Cards sit in the world as pickups, so sweep each area as you travel and grab every set you pass.
The trophy only needs 3 sets, while the 100% checklist asks for 15 of the 18, so keep collecting past the trophy if you want the platinum.
Check your set progress under Progress, then Collections, as you go, so you know which sets are one card short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots of any kind with the phone app.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan spots by holding Up and then R1 while looking at them.
Any 100 spots count, from any mix of the 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Scan as you travel rather than hunting one kind: the trophy and the 100% checklist both stop at 100 scans.
There are well over 100 scannable spots, so skip any that are awkward to reach and take the easy ones.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; most finish on their own while you play.

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; there are 10 more than the trophy needs, so pick the easiest ones.
Track them under Progress, then Challenges, where a checkmark in the bottom right shows what is done.
Leave this for late in the run: many challenges finish naturally while you work on the other trophies, and the 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app; you only need to scan them, not drive them.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app from your phone, or hold Up to use it at once, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic passing by; scanning is enough, you never need to drive the vehicle.
The 100% checklist asks for 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past the trophy, and check totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida; flying a plane over the dark patches is fastest.

steps.text: Clear the black fog from the whole map of Leonida by travelling through every area.
Fly a plane over the fogged patches: it covers ground far faster than driving.
Watch the map fill in as you fly; the trophy pops once no fog is left anywhere.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Hit 4 stars with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone.

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can play both characters together and call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause enough trouble with your partner beside you to reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone itself, not just the flashing search area; the trophy only pops once you are out of the heat.
An easy escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow; bank vault robberies also hand you 4 stars with your partner along.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while the wanted level never drops.

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner in by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Rob 3 shops in a row while the police are still chasing you, keeping the flashing wanted level alive the whole time.
Gear up first with an armored vest and sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; the pop comes about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, so hit a fourth if nothing lands.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus burst with a full focus bar and an assault rifle.

steps.text: Trigger Combat Focus by pressing L3 and R3 together while aiming a firearm; time slows and weak spots light up.
Fill your focus bar first with food and drinks, or by washing up at home, and carry Adrenaline to stretch the slow-motion window.
Line up 5 enemies at once, such as the guards at a gang operation, and drop them all before the focus runs out.
Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 for accuracy and full-auto fire, and wear body armor so you can step out of cover; soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly 1 km clear of the airport.

steps.text: Go to Vice City International Airport and take a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal; planes parked out on the airfield do not count.
The easiest jet sits at departure terminals E3 and E4; drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it.
Climb upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport before the trophy pops; the unlock is delayed, so keep flying.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and fire on enemies from inside it.

steps.text: Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the far south-west edge of the map, in Mariana County.
Find the tanks parked in the south of the air base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Slip into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun and empty the safe unseen.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first; it hands you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies.
Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it; kicking the door sets off the alarm.
Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave without being seen; Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and the trophy pops shortly after you walk out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the large bank vaults and escape; the vaults open in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which introduces bank vault robberies; the first vault comes free with the mission.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while a guard carries the cash and the vault stands open.
Bring your partner along: you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hand off a bag by holding Right.
The vault counts differ between sources: PowerPyx counts 8 large bank vaults in total, while KeenGamer lists 22 bank jobs; those are different categories, and both numbers are shown here.
Rob any 5 vaults for the trophy, then all 8 for the 100% checklist; each vault pays up to $205,000 and brings a 4-star wanted level, so keep a fast bike ready.

trophies.disagree_note: Bank job counts: 8 large bank vaults (PowerPyx) vs 22 bank jobs (KeenGamer) — different categories, both shown.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat; a bank vault job counts too.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is; robbing a bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck.
For an earlier shot, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius, or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray, and the trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs; there are 39 operations in total.
Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many get marked automatically from story progress.
Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed; all 39 are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window.

steps.text: Get the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee on display.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window; only the blue Banshee counts, and the pop comes slightly delayed as you drive away.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it by the bar.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini from the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar with the view in front of you and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Buy a gym membership and work out with your partner along; while one trains, the other trains too, so progress doubles.
Check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then the heart icon; the trophy pops once both sit at maximum.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile; it fills up on its own.

steps.text: Do 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; robberies, fights and clean escapes all feed it.
Turn on the notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, so a small demon face flags each counted action.
Check the count by opening the trophy itself in the trophy list; it fills passively across the other trophies, so do not grind it early.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet; the current belief ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.

steps.text: No guide has confirmed a method for this trophy yet; it is believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Keep playing normally and watch for the pop; unconfirmed trophies often land on their own as you work the rest of the list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger the UFO easter egg north-west of Starlet Motel after 2AM, alone, and help the woman it drops.

steps.text: Go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; the spawn is slightly random, so drive away and come back if it is not there.
Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, talk to the woman it drops and offer to help, then walk her back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet; the current belief is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

steps.text: No guide has confirmed a method for this trophy yet; it is believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.
Try melee kicks from a moving bike at enemies on the road, and watch for the pop; the exact trigger is still being pinned down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through fences; the total is cumulative.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew; it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 total is cumulative across all robberies, so it builds on its own while you clear the 100% checklist; bank vaults alone can hand you $205,000 in one job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops; guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest.

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across every kind of shop; the total is cumulative.
Buy guns, car mods and tattoos first, since they are the most expensive items in the game.
Every shop type counts, from the 24 Ammu-Nations and 14 mod shops to the 67 clothing stores and 11 tattoo studios.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app for about $160,000.

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; a notification adds the Vice City Real Estate app to your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app for about $160,000 in total.
The 4 story-related garages do not count toward this trophy; robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to raise the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles through Moses; buy garages first so you have parking spots.

steps.text: Wait for the Chapter 2 mission Moses, which installs the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
Buy garages first: each one adds parking spots, and every registered vehicle needs a free spot.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray.
